entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Charlie at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
My VeloBand tracker doesn't work. I need to return it.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
The pulse rate is completely wrong. It's garbage.

I see. An inaccurate pulse reading is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I can connect you with our technical support team. They have a few diagnostic steps that can usually fix that right over the phone.
Look, I don't have time for all that. I just want money back for this thing. I want a refund.
I understand you'd prefer to go straight to a return. Not a problem, let me just check the eligibility for you. Can I get your order number or the email address on the account?
Thank you. Pulling that up now... one moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 15th. That puts you at 20 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy.
Alright, I've just checked our knowledge base. It looks like our standard return policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery.
Since you're well within that 90-day window, I can absolutely process this return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to your email right now.

You'll receive that email in the next few minutes. Just attach the label to the box and drop it at the post office. Once our warehouse receives it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Can I help with anything else?
Okay. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
